My project required me to re-visit this problem. The problem is related to using the animation loop in renderUI. I've created a simple reproducible example: runGist("https://gist.github.com/hinkelman/7028850"). 

In the example, when both A & B are checked, the max value of the animation slider is greater than 2000 and clicking on the play icon has no effect. When only A (or B) is checked, and the max value of the animation slider is less than 2000, clicking the play icon has the intended effect.

Thanks for your help.

Sincerely,

Travis
